data.title: 玛露希尔 · 迷宫营地的精灵花嫁
data.description: 【迷宫营地临时礼堂·黄昏】玛露希尔穿着蓝白婚袍站在魔法阵与营火之间，长金发的辫子被头纱轻轻托起；她把捧花举到胸前，先紧张地确认魔法阵没有画错，之后才对镜头露出认真又灿烂的笑。
data.action: 营地魔法阵旁检查最后一枚符文，确认无误后举花灿烂微笑
data.lighting: orange firelight mixed with blue magic glow
data.mood: 认真精灵法师的花嫁仪式
data.promptProse: Marcille Donato checks the last mark of the camp's ceremonial magic circle before lifting her glowing dungeon-flower bouquet and smiling earnestly toward the viewer. Her blue-and-white elven bridal robe and veil frame golden braids and pointed ears. The vertical medium-full view places the campfire beside the circle and rough stone behind. Orange firelight warms one sleeve and cheek; blue magic outlines the circle, reflecting along the gown hem and nearby stones.
